visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white Corgi stands on a patch of grass, tilting its head back to gaze up at a large dark brown goat. The goat has its front hooves propped up on the horizontal bar of a rusty metal fence, leaning over a green mesh net to look down at the dog. The enclosure is bounded by wire fencing and wooden posts, with a sparse canopy of vines and branches overhead. The ground inside the goat's pen is dark soil, while the outside path is covered in short grass and scattered weeds. (2) As the Corgi turns its back on the goat enclosure, the camera follows it from a low, eye-level perspective. The dog trots away along a grassy edge, passing a stack of three grey concrete cinder blocks. The metal fence of the enclosure continues on the right side of the frame. In the background, the landscape opens up to reveal a lush green field and a row of deciduous trees under a muted, overcast sky. (3) The Corgi continues its walk towards another Corgi that is sniffing around a large, bright orange plastic barrel situated on the grass. The path is narrow, bordered by a wire fence on one side and a line of trees on the other. The lighting is soft and even, characteristic of a cloudy day. The camera remains steady as it captures the dog's movement through the rural farm environment.
